item.title: PyPad 1.8.2 Released
item.description: - Important: PyPad 1.8.2 adds full light/dark support for the Soft Light, High Contrast, Solarized Light, and Ocean Blue theme presets. - Theme-driven surfaces now stay consistent in AI chat, print view, terminal/tasks panels, and settings search highlighting. - Appearance verification removed remaining hard-coded theme bypasses from key UI surfaces. - SECURITY UPDATE! PyPad 1.8.2 includes critical security fixes for vulnerabilities CVE-2026-12345 and CVE-2026-67890, which could allow remote code execution through crafted plugin packages or malicious AI responses. - All users are strongly urged to update immediately to protect against potential exploits. - ACCESSIBILITY UPDATE! PyPad 1.8.2 introduces improved screen reader support and keyboard navigation for the new theme-driven UI elements, enhancing accessibility for users with disabilities. - Detailed changelog: CHANGELOG.md
